title: Feature Request: show session ID in options list for `claude -r`
body:
## Description

Claude Code's "resume" functionality shows a conversation-picker menu in the terminal if you don't pass in a sessionId... but if I want to invoke it programmatically (or even interactively) I need to know the sessionId.

[NOTE: I know there is a way to get this information, please don't reply with suggestions about workarounds, thank you!]

## Feature Request

Show the session ID alongside the conversation list/summary to facilitate non-interactive workflows, or in general to make it easier to find the conversation that I want to resume.

For instance, the suggested ["Session management workflow"](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code/sdk#session-management) is not ergonomic.
author: hesreallyhim

top_comments.author: gchamon
top_comments.body:
a quick way to list all session ids would be to get them from the actual history of claude:

```bash
cat ~/.claude/projects/$PROJECT_FOLDER/* | jq -r .sessionId | sort | uniq
```

`$PROJECT_FOLDER` can be derived from `$PWD`:

```bash
pwd | tr '/' '-'
```

This will generate a list of IDs that you can plug right into `claude -r`.
